scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend "npm --prefix backEnd run dev" "npm --prefix frontEnd run dev"
scripts.validate:frontend: npm --prefix frontEnd run lint && npm --prefix frontEnd test && npm --prefix frontEnd run build
scripts.validate:backend: npm --prefix backEnd test && npm --prefix backEnd run build
scripts.audit:prod: npm --prefix frontEnd audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix backEnd audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.validate: npm run validate:frontend && npm run validate:backend && npm run audit:prod
